summary: Li Bang International Corporation Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy for an extraordinary general meeting on September 21, 2026. Proposals seek to increase authorized share capital from US$35,000 (17.5M shares) to US$7,000,000 (3.5B shares) and reduce par value from US$0.002 to US$0.00001 via capital reduction. These are routine capital structure maintenance actions, not a special-situation transaction. The filing is incorporated by reference into its Form F-3. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is indicated. What to watch: shareholder approval and any subsequent capital-raising under the F-3.
